description: Test configurations. Select one with EDR_CONFIG=fixtures/config/<file> from the project root (catalogue paths are relative to the project root); set options.scenario of the DEMO_DATA sources (and of live-secondary) to the scenario under test. Provider identifiers used by tests come only from these files and fixtures/football-data. No DEMO_DATA source is ever linked with a LIVE_DATA or MANUAL_DATA source (OD-24) except in the invalid configuration made to prove the startup refusal.

configs.purpose: DEMO only: demo-a primary, demo-b verification and official publication; links copa-demo and liga-demo
DEMO plus manual (same sources as config/app.config.json); base of the e2e harness (T24). The manual adapter stops startup with "adapter not available" until T50 is integrated
DEMO with a separate official publication source demo-official (own independence group); for the disputed-resolved, disputed-unavailable and disputed-no-match scenarios
DEMO with demo-b configured accepted: false; for the unaccepted-source scenario
LIVE-shaped: the football-data adapter with its base URL and reference code CL, link copa-continental binding competition cl; needs FOOTBALL_DATA_API_TOKEN at startup (adapter T49)

LIVE-shaped plus the test-only LIVE_DATA source live-secondary (adapter kind test-live, registered only through the createSportsSources test seam, T41) in the verification role, accepted, own independence group, linked to the reference-shaped competition (R-256)

configs.expectProblem: use the same adapter kind and base URL origin but different independence groups
configs.purpose: two football-data sources with one origin in different independence groups (OD-24 rule a)

configs.expectProblem: binds the DEMO_DATA source 'demo-a' together with the LIVE_DATA or MANUAL_DATA source 'football-data'
configs.purpose: a catalogue link mixing a DEMO_DATA and a LIVE_DATA source (OD-24 rule b)
